en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: I said to Abu Abdullah (as): "A blind man and a weak woman are traveling with an Arab camel driver. After departing from Arafat, he takes them directly to Mina without stopping at Jam‘ (Muzdalifah)."
Imam (as) said: "Did they not pray there (at Jam‘)? If so, it suffices for them."
I asked: "What if they did not pray there?"
Imam (as) replied: "If they remembered Allah (swt), the Almighty, while there, then it suffices for them."
